groups.defect: In Google updateEvent (lines 254-256), the fallback runs only when externalCalendarId is falsy, yet it searches for cal.externalId === externalCalendarId. That lookup can never match, so calendarId ends up undefined and the old destination-calendar fallback is lost. deleteEvent (lines 315-317) has the same dead lookup.

answer.reasoning:
**Grouping:** Both judges agree on the grouping, and it is clearly right. All four suggestions:
- point at the same lines (254-256),
- report the same lookup against an already-falsy externalCalendarId that can never match,
- say the same lookup in deleteEvent (lines 315-317) is also broken.

**Where they disagree:** Only on the kind and on needsUnifiedComment.

**Kind:** I chose same_location because every member points at lines 254-256. Each one already covers the deleteEvent copy, so no member adds a separate location or a defect the others lack.

**needsUnifiedComment:** I set it to false because any one member's comment already says everything the group says.

**The other reading:** Fixing this takes two edits, one in updateEvent and one in deleteEvent. That makes systemic_pattern with needsUnifiedComment=true a defensible label, so the label is a judgment call.
